plugins.name: ai-mentor
plugins.description: Describe your engineering problem, get the right AI workflow. Ranked, verified recommendations with ready-to-paste prompts that teach you why each approach works — not just how.

plugins.name: soundings
plugins.description: Take soundings before you ship. Analyzes GitHub/GitLab compare URLs and produces a 0-100 release confidence score with an actionable risk report: categorized concerns, compound-risk detection across repositories, and actionable checks. No external LLM API, no service-account keys - the agent does the analysis, a small Go helper does the fetching.

plugins.name: soundings-app-interface
plugins.description: Release confidence analysis for Red Hat app-interface merge requests, built on soundings.

plugins.name: togi
plugins.description: Captures AI coding friction — corrections, clarifications, denied tool calls — in-session at no extra cost, and turns recurring doc gaps into context-doc pull requests.
